hints: With the lid off, the reading went up. Where could the extra mass have come from?

Oxygen is an ingredient in this reaction, like eggs in a cake. The eggs end up inside the cake. In the same way, oxygen atoms join the iron and stay there. So the new solid weighs as much as the iron plus the oxygen.
Keep the lid off and use 4 g of steel wool. More iron grabs more oxygen. How far do you think the reading will climb?
